title: carya glabra var. hirsuta
intro: Carya glabra var. hirsuta, commonly known as Hairy Shagbark Hickory, is a deciduous tree native to eastern North America, characterized by its distinctive shaggy bark and edible nuts. The Hairy Shagbark Hickory is valued for its health benefits, particularly in aiding digestion and relieving symptoms of anxiety and stress due to its adaptogenic properties. The therapeutic actions of Carya glabra var. hirsuta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant also exhibit immunomodulatory and anti-cancer properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
